summary: Each red cell on the bottom row starts an independent walker. At every state it first moves up when the cell above is in bounds and not gray. If gray is above, it moves one cell right when that cell is in bounds and not gray, then again prefers up. It stops on the top row, at the right edge with gray above, or when gray blocks both above and right. Every visited cell becomes red; all other cells are preserved.
